bagPolicy.summary: Bags must be smaller than 12 × 12 inches. Backpacks and large purses are prohibited; the venue cannot check oversized items.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue is at 1050 S. Hill Street and links to reservable nearby parking through ParkWhiz; it does not list a fixed event parking price.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue visit page does not publish a designated rideshare pickup or drop-off area.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The Belasco offers food and beverage packages and has accessible concession stands; outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The main floor has an ADA area reached by ramp, with accessible restrooms; there is no elevator. Request assistive listening at least two days ahead or an interpreter at least two weeks ahead.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue does not permit guests to leave and come back in.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Ticketmaster will call opens at door time or the meet-and-greet check-in time. Bring photo ID and the payment card used for the order.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Door times are listed by event; the box office is open only on show days and will call begins at doors or meet-and-greet check-in.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
